title: Deep learning guided design of protease substrates
core_idea: Present CleaveNet, an end-to-end AI pipeline that combines a multi-output sequence-to-function predictive model (which assigns continuous cleavage scores across multiple proteases) with a generative model that produces peptide substrates either unconditionally or conditioned on desired protease cleavage profiles, enabling targeted nomination of candidate substrates from the vast peptide sequence space.
tldr: CleaveNet is an AI pipeline for scalable, tunable in silico design of peptide substrates for proteases—combining prediction of continuous cleavage efficiencies across proteases with conditional sequence generation—and is applied to the matrix metalloproteinase family to guide experimental substrate selection.
